description: The deliverable is findings. Done means findings are evidence-backed, coverage is stated and every unknown is recorded. The criteria are exactly the three an audit path can supply - context understood, canonical ownership, source and data contracts - because a profile demanding a verdict no stage in its template owns is a profile that can never complete.
